description: Calculate expected values, best current expected-value action, perfect-information upper bound, optional imperfect-signal information value and net value after information cost. Handles maximize payoff or minimize cost; does not infer probabilities, certify decisions or model risk aversion. Returns a calculation receipt with inputs, results, assumptions, validation checks and source. The receipt is unsigned, not independent certification. No private data, external lookup or arbitrary code execution. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.

informationCost.description: Nonnegative information cost in the same units as payoffs.

objective.description: Maximize expected payoff or minimize expected cost; assumes risk-neutral expected-value preferences.

payoffs.description: Rows are actions; columns are mutually exclusive, exhaustive states.

items.description: Payoff for this action and state; same scale as information cost.

stateProbabilities.description: One probability per state, summing to one.
